title: Voice in a dream urges him to speak

tellings.quote: one night while I was sleeping I heard, "What are you afraid of? Why aren't you speaking? You met with us, didn't you?"

plain: One night after his 1997 encounter, a voice came to him in his sleep and asked, "What are you afraid of? Why aren't you speaking? You met with us, didn't you?" So says Kiran Ilum Xenov, billed on the episode as a former president of one of Russia's republics. He tells it as his own experience, saying it pushed him to speak publicly about being taken by aliens.
